text:
incident-bot: 🚨 INCIDENT OPENED: continuous-batching perf cliff in us-west-2 (high concurrency). Pager triggered for @tim_oncall and @sre_jen.

tim_oncall: seeing P99 latency spike ~700ms and 502s rising. error-rate up 8%. queues backing up.

maya: confirming — dashboard shows backlog on cb-frontend pool, microbatch sizes are spiking (avg 8 -> 25). KV cache eviction rate went through roof.

alexg: are we seeing prefetch storms? Any recent rollout?

maya: small routing heuristic rolled at 03:10 that increased prefetch concurrency. suspecting prefetched KV bloom.

alexg: ok reduce prefetch concurrency and pin batching window to lower bound. can someone flip the hotpatch?

sre_jen: applying hotfix: reduce continuous_batch.max_window_ms from 120 -> 40 and set prefetch.max_inflight 50 -> 12. pushing now.

ops-bot: deploy triggered by sre_jen: patch/cb-prefetch-throttle @ 1798123512 — CI checks green.

tim_oncall: after hotfix: latency P99 down to ~220ms, error-rate from 8% -> 1.6%. queue length trending down.

product_ryan: any customer impact so far? Saw a couple of 502s for a few enterprise customers — paging sales to notify.

maya: quick grep of logs for 502s: 18 distinct API keys affected, all high concurrency. likely transient; recommend reaching out with incident notice.

alexg: left a conservative rollback on kernel selector to avoid quantization fallback thrash. also enabled model-fallback to smaller variant for a subset of traffic.

sre_jen: note — enabling model-fallback increased CPU usage but kept tail latency within SLO. watching.

incident-bot: NOTE: add postmortem tag 'cb-prefetch-congestion' and assign to tim_oncall and maya.

tim_oncall: handing off to night shift @maya in 25m. current state: hotfix applied, queue draining, KV eviction rate down 72%. still watching jitter; might need microbatch caps tightened.

maya: I'll keep shadow alerts on and add an automated throttle threshold to prefetch if queue growth > 30% over 1m.

alexg: config snippet I pushed for safety:
```
continuous_batch:
  max_window_ms: 40
  microbatch_max: 12
prefetch:
  max_inflight: 12
  backoff_ms: 100
```

maya: metrics after 15m: throughput stable, P50/P90 good, P99 still a bit noisy at 310ms but trending down.

product_ryan: I'll prepare a short customer note: "We experienced elevated latency and transient errors due to backend prefetching and batching interactions. A targeted configuration rollback was applied; services are stable. Follow-up PM with root cause coming."

sre_jen: follow-ups: 1) revert routing heuristic rollout and re-evaluate prefetch heuristics 2) add rate-limits by API key during surge 3) stress test cb with high-concurrency workload in staging.

tim_oncall: tickets created: INF-1342 (postmortem), ENGOPS-987 (prefetch heuristics), LOADTEST-55 (staging soak).

ops-bot: pager cleared by tim_oncall @ 1798123700 — incident moved to monitoring state.

maya: handoff notes to next shifts: keep prefetch.max_inflight=12, monitor kv_evictions/min, watch microbatch_avg and queue_length. escalation if P99 > 500ms or error-rate > 2% for 5min.

alexg: reminder — we should add a circuit-breaker that prevents prefetch ramp when continuous_batch queue > threshold. filing a design doc now.

tim_oncall: thanks team. rough 30m triage, hotpatch worked. will write up timeline in INF-1342 tonight.

incident-bot: INCIDENT STATUS: monitoring. severity: Sev2 -> degraded impact, customer notices sent by product_ryan.
